scope: Remaining Round-12 Wikipedia references: 12 previously blank existing game keys and seven newly added Round-12 Game keys. Earthsiege 2 is excluded because the existing earthsiege-followup/wikipedia-links.json already supplies the same exact direct article. The other three Round-12 candidate keys with existing URLs are also excluded.

entries.note: The article has a dedicated “Advanced Daisenryaku: Deutsch Dengeki Sakusen” section identifying it as a Mega Drive war game, and the console table lists that exact title on Mega Drive. This matches the catalog project’s Mega Drive target; the game key uses its shortened title.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key; no other candidate key is being merged.

entries.game_key: Bokura no Kazoku: My Family Growing Up in the 21st Century (Japan)
entries.note: Dedicated article identifies the Japan-only 2005 PlayStation 2 simulation game Bokura no Kazoku; the key’s English explanatory subtitle and region are additional catalog qualifiers.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key.

entries.note: Dedicated article identifies HyperBlade as a 1996 Windows 95 game and describes its Direct3D support. The game key’s executable version is a build-level qualifier for this same Windows target.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key.

entries.note: Dedicated article identifies Mister Mosquito as a PlayStation 2 game, matching the original target for the Windows recompilation project.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key.

entries.note: The article has a distinct “On Fire Edition” section identifying it as a remastered Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 downloadable edition released in October 2011; this directly covers the catalog’s Xbox 360 target.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key; use the 2010 game article because it explicitly covers the named 2011 edition.

entries.game_key: Populous: The Beginning (1998) and Undiscovered Worlds expansion
entries.note: Dedicated article identifies the 1998 Windows game and explicitly states that Bullfrog released its Undiscovered Worlds expansion in 1999, matching both parts of the key.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry covers the base game and its named expansion under one existing game_key.

entries.game_key: Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike: Fight for the Future (Arcade CPS3, sfiii3nr1)
entries.note: Dedicated article identifies the 1999 arcade fighting game, lists CP System III as its arcade hardware, and discusses the arcade revisions; it also documents console ports. The article directly covers the CPS3 arcade game named by the key.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key; no separate article was found for the sfiii3nr1 revision.

entries.game_key: Super Mario Galaxy (USA Wii RMGE01 revision 0)
entries.note: Dedicated article identifies the 2007 Wii game Super Mario Galaxy. The USA disc ID/revision in the key specifies a particular build of that game.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key.

entries.game_key: Transformers (PlayStation 2, PAL SLES-52388; North American title: Transformers Armada: Prelude to Energon)
entries.note: The article’s “Related media – Video game” section identifies the PlayStation 2 game as originally called Transformers Armada: Prelude to Energon and later simply titled Transformers, and gives North American and European release details. This exactly resolves the PAL game identity and its North American alias.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key; the article is about Armada but contains a dedicated description of the matching PS2 game.

entries.note: Dedicated article identifies Vagrant Story as a 2000 Square game developed and published for PlayStation; the USA disc identifier is a build qualifier.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key.

entries.game_key: White Knight Chronicles II (USA BLUS30784, disc v01.00)
entries.note: Dedicated article identifies White Knight Chronicles II as a PlayStation 3 role-playing game and gives the North American release date; the key’s disc ID/version selects the USA release.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key.

entries.note: Dedicated article identifies Zombie Revenge as a 1999 arcade game with a Dreamcast port and discusses the Dreamcast version. The Europe disc code is an edition qualifier for that game.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for this exact existing game_key.

entries.game_key: Yoshi’s Island: Super Mario Advance 3 (USA, Game Boy Advance)
entries.note: The dedicated Yoshi’s Island article states that the game was ported to Game Boy Advance under the exact title Yoshi’s Island: Super Mario Advance 3 and describes the GBA version. This is the platform/edition in the key.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry covers the exact new Game key; the article’s page title omits the GBA subtitle but directly documents that edition.

entries.game_key: WWF WrestleMania: The Arcade Game (Arcade, Wolf Unit REV 1.30)
entries.note: Dedicated article identifies the arcade video game, lists Midway Wolf Unit hardware, and distinguishes arcade from home ports. The key narrows it to Wolf Unit revision 1.30.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for the exact new Game key; revision 1.30 is a build-level qualifier not separately described in the article.

entries.note: Dedicated Bully article explicitly identifies Anniversary Edition as the updated Scholarship Edition release for Android and iOS. It does not cover the ARM64 v1.4.311 build identifier, which is a build-level qualifier.
entries.dedupe_note: One entry for the exact new Game key; use the article only for its covered Anniversary Edition identity, not as evidence for the build number.
